# Notification

```ts
import { Notification } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A persistent notification-center card (Figma "Notifications", node 113:5543). Use it for a browsable list of past events — an inbox, a bell-icon panel, an activity feed — where each item carries an unread state and a timestamp and stays until the user dismisses it.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error' \| 'neutral'` | `'info'` | Semantic treatment (Figma status: info/success/warning/error/greyscale). Drives the status icon and its color; neutral is Figma's colorless "greyscale" status. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Visible heading. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Supporting copy under the title. |
| `timestamp` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Footer caption — a relative or absolute time, e.g. 7/20/22 • 8:22 PM. |
| `unread` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the notification unread: prepends a red New indicator before the timestamp in the footer. |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode \| null` | — | Leading visual. Defaults to the status glyph; pass null to hide it, or a custom node to override it. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Replacement for the default action-button group. When supplied, the default action label/handler props below are ignored. |
| `secondaryActionLabel` | `string` | — | Visible label for the default low-emphasis secondary action. |
| `onSecondaryAction` | `React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Fired when the default secondary action is activated. |
| `secondaryActionDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the default secondary action. |
| `primaryActionLabel` | `string` | — | Visible label for the default high-emphasis primary action. |
| `onPrimaryAction` | `React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Fired when the default primary action is activated. |
| `primaryActionDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the default primary action. |
| `onDismiss` | `React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Fired when the close control is activated. The close button only renders when this is supplied. |
| `dismissLabel` | `string` | `'Dismiss notification'` | Accessible name for the close control. |
| `flush` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders flush — no own corner radius or drop shadow — so the card tiles inside a list/panel that provides the rounding, clipping, and dividers. NotificationPanel sets this on its items. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<Notification status="info" title="Title" description="…" timestamp="7/20/22 • 8:22 PM" />
<Notification status="success" title="Backup complete" unread timestamp="9:00 AM" />
<Notification
  status="warning"
  title="Storage almost full"
  description="You're using 95% of your plan."
  timestamp="7/20/22 • 8:22 PM"
  unread
  secondaryActionLabel="Dismiss"
  primaryActionLabel="Manage"
  onPrimaryAction={openStorage}
  onDismiss={() => remove(id)}
/>
```

## Accessibility

- The card is an <article> labelled by its title and described by its description, so assistive tech announces the whole notification as a unit.
- The unread state is visible text ("New"), not color alone — it's read out, satisfying WCAG 1.4.1.
- The close control only renders when onDismiss is supplied, and reuses IconButton (Radix AccessibleIcon), so it always has the accessible name dismissLabel.
- If notifications arrive live (e.g. pushed into an open panel), make the container an aria-live="polite" region — don't turn each card into a live region.
- Actions keep the Figma &Button Group order: Secondary before Primary.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use for a durable, browsable list of notifications. | Use for transient "saved"/"failed" feedback — that's Toast. |
| Mark unattended items unread; clear it once seen. | Leave everything unread forever. |
| Keep the title short; put detail in description. | Pack a paragraph into the title. |
| Offer at most one primary + one secondary action. | Stack more than two actions in a card. |
